title: Education for All
description: The lesson that turns the vocabulary of the unit into an argument, and reads three kinds of page that are not read like ordinary prose: the acronym, a name folded into the first letter of each of its words and unfolded again by reading those letters in order (the eleven bodies of the table, the four that share a W and are separated only by the second letter, and the three the book stops to explain - UNESCO for education, science and culture, UNICEF for children's rights and everything a child needs, the WFP for hunger); the graph, where you read the title and the date before a single slice, where the eight shares of one whole must come to a hundred, where a distribution says where the children are and never how bad each place is, and where the percentage column and the head-count column are the same thing in two units, so a missing box can be worked out; the phrase out of school and the exclusion the report was written to measure; the three new words acronyms, enrolment and therefore, with the gap between a register that counts names once a year and an attendance that counts faces every day; the UNICEF page built on a sum instead of a sentence, what an equation does that a sentence cannot, and the purpose that every part of the page is aimed at; the exercise where words are printed unfinished, and the two things - the letters and the length, then the sense - that have to agree before a word goes in; and finally the structure the whole unit will argue in, if plus a negative verb equal to unless plus a positive one, with the second negative that reverses the sentence, the clause unless does not touch, the difference from if, and the way a single unless sentence settles both cases at once
sources: Official programme transcript - content/programmes-officiels/programme/bac-math/anglais.md, Unit 2 "EDUCATION MATTERS" UNIT OUTLINE (p. 87, lesson 2: Reading - Exploiting a graph and data / Reading an ad; Speaking - Understanding acronyms; Expressing opinion, Hypothesizing, If / Unless; no pronunciation focus) and Unit 2 lesson 2 "Education for all" (p. 93-96)

Pupil's Book - SKILLS For LIFE, Fourth Year Secondary Education, CNP Tunisia 241403P00, Unit 2 lesson 2 "Education for all", p. 93-96 (the Acronym / Organization table of eleven rows p. 93, the pie chart "REGIONAL DISTRIBUTION OF CHILDREN OUT OF SCHOOL, 2001/02" with its eight printed shares and its UNESCO Institute for Statistics source line p. 93, the UIS extract and the Region / Percentage / Number of children table p. 94, the UNICEF advertisement with its unfinished words and its "Grade 2 + $1 = Grade 3" visual p. 95, the GRAMMAR FOCUS on If / Unless and the quotation attributed to Aristotle p. 95-96, and the MY NEW WORDS / MY GRAMMAR / WHAT I CAN DO NOW boxes p. 96)

Teacher's Book - SKILLS For LIFE, CNP Tunisia 641404, KEY of Unit 2 lesson 2 (p. 24) - re-solved before use: the acronym matching and the seven If / Unless transformations are given no key at all, so the eleven pairs were read back from the initials printed opposite each name and the rule was taken from the MY GRAMMAR box; the missing cells of the regional table are not re-given either, and were read from the printed UIS extract (21.4 million of 115 million = 18.6 %); the guide's "Useful hints" supply the founding years and the stated role of UNESCO, UNICEF and the WFP, and its keys supply enrolment/therefore, the eight completed words of the ad, the purpose of the ad and the answer that an equation is what draws the reader's attention

Bornes de la R-7 du 2026-08-05 - le GRAMMAR REFERENCE (ADD-ONS p.261-271) ne contient AUCUNE entree sur If / Unless : ses douze entrees vont de "Verb + to + verb or + verb + gerund" a "Timeline chart", et sa seule mention d'une conditionnelle porte sur l'inversion formelle (Had he understood..., Should he decide...), qui n'est ni enseignee ni testee ici. Le point de langue est donc traite au seul niveau que posent l'encadre MY GRAMMAR verbatim de la p.96 (If + negative verb = Unless + positive verb), la cle du guide p.24 sur l'equation UNICEF ("A contains a negative verb after IF but b an affirmative verb after UNLESS") et les sept transformations du GRAMMAR FOCUS p.95-96, dont le guide ne donne aucun corrige : la portee de unless (une seule proposition - les sept items laissent la principale intacte), l'interdiction du second negatif et l'ordre libre des deux propositions (quatre items ouvrent sur la conditionnelle, trois la placent en second) se lisent tous dans ce materiel. En revanche l'idee qu'une phrase en unless regle AUSSI le cas favorable n'y est pas ecrite : c'est une convention de lecture, le chapitre la donne comme telle (explication de 01-pratique q5) et le seul item qui en depend la fait poser explicitement par son enonce ("The notice gives no other way of losing a key"). Ce chapitre s'interdit en consequence les conditionnels de type 2 et 3, les mixtes, l'inversion conditionnelle et tout emploi de unless hors de la conditionnelle reelle. R-2 : aucun texte sous droits n'est reproduit - le camembert, l'extrait UIS et la publicite UNICEF sont decrits et non recopies, la sentence attribuee a Aristote est paraphrasee, et les lignes a mots tronques du cours et des exercices sont fabriquees sur le modele de la page (le cours le dit en toutes lettres), jamais copiees sur elle. Ce que le chapitre AJOUTE aux encadres, declare ici pour que cette borne soit vraie : (1) les onze developpes du tableau p.93 sont ceux que le manuel imprime, et plusieurs ne sont pas le libelle que l'organisation elle-meme emploie aujourd'hui (World Wide Fund, Oil Producing and Exporting Countries) - choix assume pour le bac, et le cours comme le resume le disent desormais en toutes lettres au lieu de les donner pour des faits du monde ; (2) la somme de la colonne des effectifs vaut 115.3 M quand la ligne de total imprime 115 : le cours enonce l'arrondi au dixieme plutot que de laisser l'eleve qui verifie se croire fautif - c'est de l'arithmetique sur les chiffres imprimes, aucune donnee nouvelle ; (3) 7.6 % de 115 M donne 8.74 et non le 8.8 imprime par l'UIS, l'ecart venant de l'arrondi de la part elle-meme : l'explication de 03-revision q6 le dit au lieu d'affirmer une egalite fausse.
